package unformatted

import "strings"

// gofmt strips the parentheses around an if statement's condition, and the original takes the condition as written,
// so a parenthesized guard is no call to it and is not reported, either form.
func parenthesizedConditions(text string, affix string) {
	if (strings.HasPrefix(text, affix)) {
		text = text[len(affix):]
	}
	if ((strings.HasPrefix(text, affix))) {
		text = strings.TrimPrefix(text, affix)
	}
	// The same guards unparenthesized are reported, so the fixture holds findings to compare.
	if strings.HasPrefix(text, affix) {
		text = text[len(affix):]
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(text, affix) {
		text = strings.TrimPrefix(text, affix)
	}
	_ = text
}
